notes: §2002:7.2.2 SR7 'A compiler-directive word is reserved within the context of the compiler directive in which it is specified'. The reservation is asked only by the three sites that read a directive's operand (DEFINE name, defined condition, TURN file-name); no word table reaches the reserved-word screen of the program text. Run at --std 2002 and --std 2023 with this build: a program that declares data items SOURCE-FORMAT and LISTING (words of every edition's §8.12) outside any directive compiles and prints 12 (kb/Work PB5599).
